server.name: kain-agent-mcp
server.title: Kain Agent MCP
server.description: Runtime-native MCP for Kain language understanding, semantic repo search, examples, and command execution.

instructions: Use stdlib.query and repo.examples before broad repo spelunking. Treat the command registry tools as the first stop for Kain CLI understanding, then use kain.check and kain.run_plan when you need execution truth.

understanding_paths.purpose: Durable architectural map and ownership boundaries.
Fast vocabulary map for repo- and language-specific terms.
Agent-first atlas of the root stdlib surface.
Cross-lane proving ground that shows how Kain features compose.
Experimental authored system with semantic density.

tools.name: repo.overview
tools.title: Repo Overview
tools.description: Return the Kain repo orientation map: docs, major roots, and stdlib summary counts.

tools.name: stdlib.query
tools.title: Stdlib Query
tools.description: Query the generated stdlib atlas through query_stdlib.py without shelling out manually.

tools.name: repo.examples
tools.title: Repo Examples
tools.description: Find authored Kain examples across library_of_kain, smoketest, experiments, UI, and GPU lanes.

tools.name: repo.search
tools.title: Repo Search
tools.description: Semantic text search across the repo through ripgrep with concise structured matches.

tools.name: kain.commands.list
tools.title: Kain Commands List
tools.description: Return structured command-registry entries for the selected Kain binary view.

tools.name: kain.commands.describe
tools.title: Kain Commands Describe
tools.description: Describe one Kain command by id or command path such as `check` or `run plan`.

tools.name: kain.check
tools.title: Kain Check
tools.description: Run `kain check` through the MCP and return the structured report when available.

tools.name: kain.run_plan
tools.title: Kain Run Plan
tools.description: Run `kain run plan --json` and return the resolved execution plan for a path or workspace.
